lessons_used: Reordering sign-in steps was helpful in 3 winning tests (+9.0%, +4.3%, and +4.8% after noise correction), while 5 tests showed no clear effect and 1 was worse.
Adding a new screen to adoption was harmful, as both tests agreed on a negative impact after noise correction (-2.4% and -10.3%).
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign and finish new_screen changes because their tests disagreed after noise correction.
Evidence is still thin for adoption hint, home new_flow, and choose_path reorder changes because each has only 1 test.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, particularly for tests with no clear effect or those stopped early.
Predictions were too low for the round 2 finish new_screen test (+8.0% predicted vs +9.8% noise-corrected) and round 8 sign_in reorder test (+0.8% predicted vs +9.0% noise-corrected).

candidates.title: Sign-In Account Safety Spotlight Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a spotlight layout emphasizing account protection and automatic data syncing.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing in again; highlighting account safety reduces sign-in drop-off.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Desktop Companion
sign_in.body: Sign in to ensure your pet's progress, traits, and memory are continuously saved.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': a badge cannot do the sign_in_options job (use ['button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'text'])

candidates.title: Choose Path Checklist Progress Hub Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the choose_path screen into a checklist layout showing setup milestones and estimated time.
candidates.why: Choose_path has a high mean time of 514s; presenting a clear checklist structure reduces user hesitation.

guard.reason: Redesigning choose_path into a setup checklist progress hub loses the job of offering the choice between adopting and making your own pet.

candidates.title: Post Onboarding Quick Reference Card Screen
candidates.change: Adds a new screen 'new_quick_reference' right after home_intro detailing essential mouse and keyboard controls.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets asking how to hide, control, or talk to the pet after completing setup.

new_quick_reference.headline: Quick Desktop Pet Controls
new_quick_reference.body: Learn how to summon, minimize, and interact with your new companion anytime.

guard.reason: Adding a new reference screen after home_intro is allowed during onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens tends to add friction, and previous finish/new_screen evidence is thin.

candidates.title: Home Intro Split Story Card Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns home_intro into a split layout displaying desktop pet behavior tips alongside the companion mascot.
candidates.why: Finish step mean duration is very long (5815s) and users complain about post-onboarding confusion regarding pet behavior.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Companion is Ready
home_intro.body: Click and drag your pet anywhere on screen or right-click for quick actions.

home_welcome.text: Right-click your pet on desktop anytime for options.

guard.reason: Redesigning home_intro layout while preserving its functionality is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Supported by long step duration and tickets, though redesigns carry mixed historical performance.

candidates.title: Upload Photos Validation Tips Hint
candidates.change: Adds file upload format guidance on the upload_photos screen to prevent rendering errors.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results during adoption.

upload_photos.hint: Use PNG or JPG files under 5MB with clear lighting for the best pet generation quality.

guard.reason: Adding helpful photo validation guidance to upload_photos is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from tickets and funnel drop-off, but prior adoption hint test yielded -5.9%.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Background Generation Progress Notice
candidates.change: Adds a progress bar and step counter on the waiting screen to give visual feedback during pet creation.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing uncertainty while waiting.

waiting.headline: Crafting Your Companion
waiting.body: Initializing sprite animations and AI behaviors...

guard.reason: Adding progress details and notifications to the waiting screen is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Directly addresses high wait times on the home step with visual progress feedback.

candidates.title: Sign-In Account Cloud Sync Protection Badge
candidates.change: Displays a cloud synchronization badge on the sign_in screen informing users of automatic data protection.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing after signing in again, making cloud sync guarantees critical.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect Your Companion
sign_in.hint: Syncing saves your pet's memory, level, and customizations securely to the cloud.

guard.reason: Adding a cloud sync badge and hint to sign_in without removing sign-in functionality is allowed.

candidates.score_note: High support mail volume (8 tickets); low-cost badge update on a generally responsive step.

candidates.title: Story Screen Warm Welcome Copy Clarification
candidates.change: Updates the story intro headline and body text to set clear, friendly expectations before path selection.
candidates.why: Choose_path step has a 23.8% drop-off; setting early expectations improves completion.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Create an interactive pet that lives right on your desktop while you work or play.

guard.reason: Updating intro copy on the story screen while still introducing the pet is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Config-only copy change addressing 23.8% drop-off, though support evidence is lacking.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Trait Cards Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns pick_friend with a card layout highlighting companion personalities and visual options.
candidates.why: Adoption drop-off is the largest in the funnel (60.9% conversion), requiring stronger companion engagement.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a friend with unique personality traits to accompany your daily desktop tasks.

guard.reason: Redesigning pick_friend into a card layout while retaining companion selection is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets largest drop-off step (adoption), but adoption redesigns averaged -4.1% historical lift.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Completion Desktop Notification Toggle
candidates.change: Enables notification options on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet rendering completes.
candidates.why: Median waiting time is 201s (mean 2336s); desktop notification prevents users from abandoning while waiting.

waiting.hint: We'll notify you as soon as your pet is ready to play!

guard.reason: Enabling completion notification options on the waiting screen is permitted under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Helps mitigate abandonment during long home wait times (mean 2336s) via system alerts.
